Competitors: Exclave's 'Enable debug logging + pprof HTTP server under About' is the documented prerequisite for filing issues (research/08-Exclave.md:466), WG-Tunnel's local logs monitor runs the Go core at `LOG_LEVEL=debug` with keyword filters (research/09-WG-Tunnel.md:308-310), and WireSock exposes error->info->debug->all levels (research/10-WireSock.md:516). A user whose
findings.fix: Thread a log-level option into BoxAdapter.start (libbox/CommandServer and sing-box.exe `-l` both accept it) with a Logs-toolbar control, defaulting WARN and switching to DEBUG while the screen is open.

findings.title: No in-app DNS/IP leak verification even though max firewall + leak tests are the stated differentiation
findings.evidence: grep for `dnsleak|ipleak|browserleaks` in lib/ returns nothing; the entire leak assurance surface is validateOrdering() in firewall.dart (compile-time rule checks) plus a scripts/leak_test.sh meant for CI/device runs, while SPEC.md:332-343 defines the 7 leak scenarios as E2E manual tests against dnsleaktest.com/ipleak.net and the vendored DNS module's own comment admits 'DNS leaks are the most common failure (6/16 researched VPNs leaked DNS)' (dns_config.dart:88-89). A blocked state (tunnel.dart:556-576) drops the user to firewall-enforced isolation with zero evidence of what got through. Competitors: Hiddify maintains a dedicated troubleshooting doc 'How-to-check-and-prevent-DNS-leaks' with
findings.fix: Extend Health.snapshot with a resolver-echo check (query a whoami-style DNS endpoint through the tunnel resolver and assert the answer path is the FakeIP/in-tunnel server), and surface the result on the diagnostics tab alongside hijacked.

findings.title: Blocked-state UX gives no actionable next step — no 'view logs' shortcut, no retry-with-debug, no connection to the diagnostics tab
findings.evidence: TunnelBlockReason's 6 fixed labels (tunnel.dart:14-22) are the entire error UX; every failure — even ones carrying rich messages like `_lastErrorLine` from the Windows subprocess or `PlatformException.message` from the channel — maps to one enum and the message object is dropped. There is no 'last error' field anywhere on the health/diagnostics screens, no persistent ring of recent FATALs outside the 2000-line LogBus that dies with the process. AGENTS.md states the design was 'crash detection = FATAL scan in log stream' — but the FATAL text never reaches a user-visible widget. Nekoray shows per-profile `testResult` in the table and chain errors as red badges in the list (research/04-Nekoray.
findings.fix: Capture `event.error` into a lastError line, expose it via a provider, and render it (truncated, selectable, with a copy action) in the StateTile/blocked banner and the diagnostics tab.

findings.title: No Persian-capable font bundled — pubspec.yaml has no fonts section and ThemeData uses the default; Persian renders via per-glyph OS fallback with no typography control
findings.evidence: Competitor side: research/07-Hiddify.md:435 — 'Fonts: Vazirmatn Font by Saber Rastikerdar (pubspec.yaml fonts: Shabnam + Vazirmatn) — Persian-friendly UI (makes sense for Iran focus)'. Code side: pubspec.yaml flutter: section (uses-material-design, generate, assets only — no `fonts:` entry, no google_fonts dependency); lib/app/app.dart:70-82 ThemeData(colorScheme: ColorScheme.fromSeed(...)) sets no fontFamily; windows/runner has no font registration (only ReloadSystemFonts in flutter_window.cpp:66). Result: FA
findings.fix: Bundle Vazirmatn (OFL) as a font asset, declare it in pubspec `fonts:` with Latin fallback, and set fontFamily + a `fontFamilyFallback` on the app ThemeData.

findings.title: l10n QA has a blind spot: the parity test only diffs ARB files, so hardcoded screen English never fails CI, and no widget/golden test renders the app in FA RTL
findings.evidence: Intent side: AGENTS.md:Testing mandates 'test/l10n/ (ARB golden at 200%)' and 'Evidence before synthesis'; goal.md:15 locks FA RTL + Dynamic Type as verified capabilities. Code side: test/ui/l10n_parity_test.dart:8-13 claims to catch 'the added-the-English-string-forgot-Persian regression' but only compares the two ARB files — it cannot see hardcoded literals, which is exactly how diagnostics_screen.dart and awg_profile_screen.dart (zero l10n imports) shipped fully English while tests stayed green. The golden suite (test/golden/home_golden_test.dart) renders only the default EN locale — grep for Directionality/TextDirection/fa in test/ matches only the two ui tests asserting string values; n
findings.fix: Extend the parity test to a literal scan of lib/ screens (fail on raw Text('...') strings) and add one testWidgets case + golden that pumps HomeScreen/rules sheet under Locale('fa') with textDirection RTL at 1.35 scale.

findings.title: Group form, AWG profile editor, backup dialogs and wizard are hardcoded English for FA (RTL) users
findings.evidence: goal.md:110 'EN + FA RTL + ARB' and AGENTS.md l10n rule. Code: groups form sheet hardcodes 'Edit group'/'New group' (241), 'Selector'/'Urltest' (247-248), 'Members' (263), 'Cancel'/'Save' (331/367); AWG profile sheet (the WG/AWG star feature) 'New AWG profile' (84), 'Random' (108), 'Advanced obfuscation' (120); backup password dialog 'Cancel'/'OK'/'Password' (endpoints_screen.dart:251-255); wizard 'No user apps found' (wizard.dart:327); StatsTile 'No connect yet'/'Disconnected'/'connect X ms' (home.dart:269-271). A Persian user editing AWG junk values or restoring a backup reads English mid-flow; RTL layout breaks with these Latin strings.
findings.fix: Add en/fa ARB keys for group form, AWG sheet, backup dialogs and stats strings; wire through AppLocalizations and extend the l10n parity test with a no-literal scan per screen.

findings.title: ReduceMotion guard exists in exactly one widget and has zero test coverage, contradicting the frozen a11y lock and SPEC verification plan
findings.evidence: goal.md:110 locks 'ReduceMotion'; SPEC.md:345 verification row requires 'ReduceMotion fallback (glow/bounce skipped)'. Code: exactly one MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf read exists in lib/ (home.dart:76-109, PowerTile AnimatedRotation) - the only animation currently honors the setting, but future M3E pulse/spring animations promised in goal.md UI stack would regress silently; test/ has no disableAnimations test (grep over test/ returns nothing) despite SPEC listing it as a required check.
findings.fix: Add a widget test pumping PowerTile with MediaQuery(disableAnimations: true) asserting Duration.zero duration, plus a central motion helper that new animations must consume so the guard scales beyond one widget.

findings.title: Health status is color-only: probe pass/fail and rule BLOCK use icon hue + container color with no Semantics label or text alternative
findings.evidence: SPEC.md:36 promises 'WCAG AA' for the a11y deep; WCAG 1.4.1 requires non-color means. Code: _ProbeTile encodes pass/fail purely in the trailing icon color 'good ? theme.colorScheme.primary : theme.colorScheme.error' and shape (diagnostics_screen.dart:151-153); _ScoreCard switches primaryContainer/errorContainer (diagnostics_screen.dart:74-77); rulescreen tints BLOCK 'BLOCK' icon with error color (rules_screen.dart:52-57). No Semantics(value/label) states the boolean, and grep of lib/ shows zero custom status colors - everything rides M3 fromSeed, so a color-vision-deficient user must infer from icon glyphs alone with no screen-reader signal.
findings.fix: Add Semantics(label: good ? l10n.probeOk : l10n.probeFailed, liveRegion on score change) to _ProbeTile/_ScoreCard, and append the textual verdict ('OK'/'Failed') to probe subtitles as the non-color channel.

findings.title: Dynamic-type and 200%-scale verification covers only the home screen - rules editor, groups form, endpoints, diagnostics, updates, wizard untested at ceiling
findings.evidence: SPEC.md:345 requires '200% text scale overflow check' and 'golden localization for EN/FA'; tasks/plan.md:123 checkpoint expects it at 320/375/414/768. Code: test/golden/home_golden_test.dart renders only HomeScreen (PowerTile/StatsTile goldens at 1.35 + whole-home 200% overflow pass); the 30-field rule editor (rules_screen.dart forms), group form sheet, endpoints list and wizard have no scale or FA golden - rules rows pack 'summary' + '→ outbound' subtitle plus a two-IconButton trailing Row (rules_screen.dart:50-90), the exact untested overflow-prone pattern at ceiling scale.
findings.fix: Parameterize the existing _wrap harness to pump each screen at 1.35 (clamped) and 2.0 (pre-clamp overflow assertion) in EN and FA; add goldens for the rules editor row and group form sheet.

findings.title: Wizard is a hard app-wide gate with no skip on step 1 and is dead ceremony on Windows (all three adapters are no-ops)
findings.evidence: AGENTS.md requires the wizard (VPN permission -> battery -> per-app) as onboarding; blockers note says 'wizard per-app needs adb device' implying Android-first. Code: AppShell gates every screen behind WizardStep.done (app.dart:136-142) with no skip on step 1 (wizard.dart _VpnStep has only the grant button, no Skip - contrast _BatteryStep which has l10n.skip); DesktopPlatformAdapter.isVpnPermissionGranted() returns true unconditionally and listInstalledApps() returns const [] (desktop_platform_adapter.dart:11-46), so Windows users tap through a per-app screen that is always empty, and a user who cancels the Android VPN dialog is trapped with no Skip - the whole app, including diagnostics/upd
findings.fix: Add a Skip/later action to step 1 (same l10n.skip used by battery step), skip battery+per-app steps automatically on desktop where adapters are no-ops, and persist wizard completion so the gate is one-time.

findings.title: SPEC's required a11y test suite (Semantics on icon-only, ReduceMotion, RTL golden, 200% scale) is only a comment in analysis_options.yaml - no enforcement exists
findings.evidence: SPEC.md:184 'analysis_options.yaml: flutter_lints + custom: require EdgeInsetsDirectional, require Semantics' and SPEC.md:345 lists Semantics/icon-only/TextScaler/ReduceMotion checks. Code: analysis_options.yaml:17-18 says '# YAGNI: custom lint for EdgeInsetsDirectional + Semantics enforced via code review' - no custom lint, no widget test iterates tappables for semantics; the gaps in findings 2 and 4 above are direct evidence the unenforced rule already slipped.
findings.fix: Add a widget sweep test that pumps each screen with a SemanticsHandle and asserts every IconButton/tappable has a Semantics label, plus a custom lint (or dart_code_metrics rule) for EdgeInsets.only directional misuse.

findings.title: Latency sweep has no loading state, no per-endpoint result surface, and no timeout/error label for unreachable nodes
findings.evidence: Hiddify: 'each proxy row shows delay ms... manual tap runs Box.URLTest(tag) via gRPC → returns ms or timeout/error' (research/07-Hiddify.md:381); v2rayNG testRealDelay 'returns ms or -1 failure' with per-node results (research/06-V2RayNG.md:426). QANATVPN groups_screen.dart:50-52 'Measure latency' button calls latencyProvider.refresh() with no disabled/spinner state; LatencyState (latency.dart) has only a samples map — no 'measuring' flag — and measureAll can take up to the 4s timeout, during which the UI shows nothing. Results surface only as a urltest group subtitle suffix (_bestMsSuffix ' · best N ms') and only when a member succeeded: an unreachable member (null sample) is silently omitte
findings.fix: Add a measuring flag to LatencyState (disable the button + progress indicator while _inFlight), render 'timeout' on the row/card for null samples (mirroring Hiddify), and show per-endpoint ms in the endpoints list.

findings.title: Persistence errors are invisible: corrupt store files render as a clean empty state and failed disk writes are fire-and-forget, so user data silently vanishes on restart
findings.evidence: Every store read() ends in 'on Object { return const <...>[] }' (endpoint_store.dart:52-53, policy_store.dart:24-25, rule_store.dart:22-23) — corrupt JSON renders as the screens' empty states ('endpointsEmpty'/'groupsEmpty'/'rulesEmpty') with no 'your data failed to load' error or recovery. Every save goes through DebouncedSaver.schedule whose timer callback is fire-and-forget: 'run();' with the comment 'a failed disk write must not crash the UI' (debounced_saver.dart:38-44) — a failed atomicWriteString (disk full, permission) is silently dropped, the UI keeps showing the endpoint/rule, and it disappears after restart. Clash Verge Rev's contract for the same failure class: 'on failure Verge
findings.fix: Surface write failures (return them from schedule/flush to the controllers' error state, or log a SnackBar/banner), and on corrupt-read show a distinct 'stored data unreadable' state offering backup restore (BackupService .qnv) instead of the clean empty state.

findings.title: Network loading states can hang indefinitely: URL import and update check have no total timeout and no cancel
findings.evidence: plain_fetch.dart sets only 'connectionTimeout = const Duration(seconds: 15)' — the request.close()/body fold has no overall timeout, so a stalled upload keeps the spinner alive indefinitely. endpoints_controller.dart importText sets 'importing: true' and the EndpointsScreen button shows an indeterminate 16px CircularProgressIndicator (endpoints_screen.dart:318-321) with no cancel; updates_controller.dart checkNow sets UpdateChecking and the screen shows a bare Center(CircularProgressIndicator()) (updates_screen.dart:39-43) with the 'Check now' button still enabled (no reentrancy guard, unlike latency's _inFlight). Competitor baseline for bounded network probes: v2rayNG 'LibXray.measureDelay(
findings.fix: Add a total request timeout to plainFetch (e.g. 30s), disable Check-now during UpdateChecking, and add a cancel action to the importing state that aborts the HttpClient request.

findings.title: State strings across home, diagnostics, groups, rules, wizard and AWG screens are hardcoded English despite existing l10n keys — FA/RTL users see untranslated states
findings.evidence: goal.md §15 i18n deep (frozen): 'EN + FA RTL + ARB + flutter_localizations + Semantics + Dynamic Type... (like GRoute EN/FA)'; AGENTS.md records 'UI polish (l10n everywhere...)' as done on 2026-09-02. But app_en.arb already defines unused keys diagnosticsTitle/diagnosticsRefresh while diagnostics_screen.dart renders literal Text('Diagnostics'), tooltip 'Refresh', 'DNS hijack', 'ISP resolver answering — tunnel likely down', 'unreachable', 'Stability window'. home.dart StatsTile: 'metrics == null ? 'No connect yet' : 'connect ${metrics.total.inMilliseconds} ms''; UpdateTile label '_ => 'Updates''. wizard.dart _SplitStepState: Text('No user apps found'). rules_screen.dart field labels ('Domain
findings.fix: Route every screen string through AppLocalizations (the ARB keys already exist for diagnostics/updates), and add keys for the groups/rules/AWG/wizard strings before the next FA golden pass.

findings.title: AWG profile editor cannot express the frozen value set: no I1-I5 inputs, no Id/Ip masquerade fields, and clearing any numeric field is impossible (empty input silently restores the previous value)
findings.evidence: goal.md §4 (frozen): 'ALL values: Jc/Jmin/Jmax/S1-S4/H1-H4/I1-I5 + masquerade Id/Ip/Ib... via internal awg endpoint implemented first' — this editor is the product's star screen. The model supports I1-I5 (amnezia_values.dart:24-28, and _copyWith passes them through awg_profile_screen.dart:310-314), but _advancedFields renders only 'Junk packets' (Jc/Jmin/Jmax), 'Message padding' (S1-S4) and 'Magic headers' (H1-H4) — there is no I1-I5 input, no Id/Ip/Ib, no HeaderProtectionKey. Reference editor: WG-Tunnel 'Config editor → AmneziaWG Settings... I1-I5 CPS multiline with syntax highlight' (research/09-WG-Tunnel.md:369). State defect while editing: _numField does onChanged(int.tryParse(...)) and
findings.fix: Add I1-I5 (and Id/Ip/Ib) inputs to _advancedFields, and rework _numField to own a stable TextEditingController per field with an explicit empty-means-unset parse so clearing works.

findings.title: Bento home drift: prototype's 10 tiles reduced to 7 with real content missing — no latency pill, no traffic bytes, no tuning/kill-switch posture tile, no live-connections tile; StatsTile was repurposed to connect-milliseconds
findings.evidence: Prototype home has 10 tiles: Power, 'Fastest server' with latency pill ('HKG-02 34 ms' + PROXY/MANUAL/TOR-CHAIN pills), 'Traffic today 2.4 GB ↑ 842 MB • ↓ 1.6 GB • 3 active' with progress bar, 'Tuning' (Reality+Vision+XHTTP ON, Fragment/uTLS ON, AmneziaWG H1/I1 ON, 'Kill switch max WFP'), 'Split tunneling' mode chips, 'Live connections', Onboarding, and Profiles/Updates/Security strip. Code: lib/modules/vpn/screens/home.dart grid is PowerTile, StateTile, EndpointTile, SplitTile, StatsTile, UpdateTile, WizardTile — EndpointTile shows only 'selected.tag + stored count' (no ms), StatsTile headline is 'connect ${metrics.total.inMilliseconds} ms' with phase timings — connect diagnostics, not traf
findings.fix: Surface last measured latency on EndpointTile (latencyProvider already computes it for groups), repurpose a tile to up/down bytes once byte counters are exposed via the tunnel, and add a posture tile showing active DPI/obfuscation + firewall state per selected endpoint.

findings.title: Design-language drift: material_3_expressive, material_ui, cue and fl_chart are declared in pubspec but imported zero times — the app renders stock Material 3 fromSeed, not the promised M3E look
findings.evidence: AGENTS.md overview: 'Flutter 3.47.2 + material_3_expressive 45 M3E + cue/motion_kit'; goal.md 10 locks 'material_3_expressive (45 M3E, motor, material_new_shapes, dynamic_color) + cue physics ... for smooth VPN pulse/draggable sheets/glass'. Code: pubspec.yaml declares material_3_expressive ^1.1.1, material_ui ^1.1.0, cue ^0.3.1, fl_chart ^1.2.0 — but grep 'material_3_expressive|material_ui|package:cue' across lib/ returns ZERO imports, and fl_chart is imported nowhere; lib/app/app.dart builds plain 'ThemeData(useMaterial3: true, colorScheme: ColorScheme.fromSeed(seedColor: const Color(0xFF245C4F)))' with no Fraunces/Inter/JetBrains fonts and no prototype token palette (paper oklch(98% .01 8
findings.fix: Adopt M3EMaterialApp (or ThemeData extensions) with the prototype token set + fonts, apply cue springs to tile presses, and route remaining hard-coded home/update strings through the ARB files; either use or drop the unused deps.

findings.title: Signature hero prism and connect animation absent — power tile feedback is a 350ms icon rotation, the eye-blink/pulse-ring/packet-bar identity is nowhere in the app
findings.evidence: Prototype design plan comment: 'Signature: tunnel prism — live packet obfuscation visual (Jc/Jmin/H1/I1 as moving bars) + character eye blink on connect'; the .prism hero shows beams + eye with blink keyframe on connect, Jc 6 / H1 101 / I1 12b / S1 8 / uTLS chrome labels; power tile has .pulse ring animations (3 expanding rings) and the state sub reads 'Reality+AmneziaWG H1/I1 • 1 TUN fork'. Code: lib/modules/vpn/screens/home.dart PowerTile motion is only 'AnimatedRotation(turns: connected ? 0.5 : 0, duration: 350ms)' of a power icon; grep 'AnimatedContainer|AnimatedScale|pulse' in lib/ returns zero. The AWG obfuscation values the product exists to showcase (Jc/H1/I1, stored in awg_profile_s
findings.fix: Add an animated connect visual (CustomPainter pulse rings via AnimationController with ReduceMotion guard, honoring the existing MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf pattern) and a live AWG-values strip (Jc/H1/I1 of the selected endpoint) in the power or state tile.

findings.title: DNS scanner reduced to one boolean hijack probe + composite score — the promised per-resolver 0-6 scan with EDNS/NXDOMAIN/RND/DPI badges, UDP/TCP modes, and Prism HMAC verification does not exist
findings.evidence: Prototype diagnostics: resolver table rows '8.8.8.8 → score 6, badges NS✓ TXT✓ RND✓ DPI✓ EDNS(1232) NXD✓, E2E WORKING 34ms / 192.0.2.1 → score 2 TIMEOUT', buttons 'Simple (all resolvers)' / 'Advanced 0–6' / 'Prism HMAC', sheet text 'EDNS probing, NXDOMAIN hijack detection, 0–6 score ... UDP/TCP/Both, workers 50'. goal.md 5.1 locks 'Slipnet-like DNS scanner 0–6 + Prism HMAC + Simple Ping TCP 5000ms'. Code: lib/modules/health/health.dart FakeIpDnsProber.isHijacked() is a single wildcard lookup of 'probe.qanatvpn.internal' checked against the FakeIP pool; HealthReport = {score, hijacked, pingMs, stability}; lib/modules/health/diagnostics_screen.dart renders one score card + 3 ListTiles (hijack b
findings.fix: Add a DnsScanner module that probes a configurable resolver list over UDP and TCP (using RawSocket) with NXDOMAIN/EDNS/DoH tests, scores each 0-6, and render the per-resolver table with badges in DiagnosticsScreen; Prism HMAC check can ship as a follow-up behind the diagnostics refresh action.

findings.title: No traceroute / per-hop PingRoute and no sort-by-ping anywhere — endpoints list has no latency column, so picking a fast node is blind
findings.evidence: Prototype ping tile: 'Ping all (TCP 5000ms)', 'Sort by ping', 'Traceroute' buttons and 'PingRoute per-hop • Min/Max/Avg/Last • fl_chart' chart. goal.md 5.1 locks 'Simple Ping TCP 5000ms + sort by ping + ... PingRoute per-hop'. Code: grep 'traceroute|per-hop' across lib/ returns zero; lib/modules/routing/latency.dart LatencyController sweeps only known group/endpoint tags and lib/modules/routing/groups_screen.dart shows it via '_bestMsSuffix' — a 'Measure latency' button lives on the Groups tab, not on endpoints or diagnostics; lib/modules/vpn/repositories/endpoints_screen.dart has no latency reference at all (grep latency in that file: zero) — the endpoint list shows protocol + source URL on
findings.fix: Reuse LatencyController for an endpoint-list ping-all + sort-by-ping control, move the 'Measure latency' action to the endpoints screen where selection happens, and add a traceroute (UDP/TTL via RawSocket or ICMP through platform channel) view with per-hop min/avg/last.

findings.title: Backup lock only half-shipped: encrypted local .qnv exists, WebDAV and LAN ZIP absent
findings.evidence: goal.md section 11: "backup/WebDAV+LAN ZIP" and intent.md 2.8: "Karing iCloud/WebDAV/LAN ZIP + FlClash WebDAV drift | Yes, WebDAV + LAN ZIP". Code: BackupService implements only a local encrypted envelope (Argon2id+AES-GCM, backup_service.dart:18-27) surfaced via FilePicker.saveFile/.pickFiles of a .qnv file (endpoints_screen.dart:148-200); grep webdav|dav in lib returns zero hits — no remote target, no LAN discovery/ZIP share, so backup is manual file shuffling.
findings.fix: Add a WebDAV destination (server URL + credentials in secure storage) for the existing encrypted envelope, and a LAN ZIP share entry point reusing the same exportBytes payload.

findings.title: DPI lock gap: Fragment and ShadowTLS/AnyTLS/Mieru/Juicity outbound types absent (only Reality/uTLS/XHTTP/ECH/salamander shipped)
findings.evidence: goal.md section 5: "All ON + ECH v1: Reality, Vision, XHTTP, uTLS, Fragment, ECH, AnyTLS/ShadowTLS/Salamander, obfuscated WG junk"; intent.md 2.3: "Yes, fragment + mixed-case + XHTTP". Code: parsers accept only vless/vmess/ss/trojan/hysteria2/tuic/wireguard/ssh schemes (parsers.dart:143-216); endpoint_outbound emits reality/utls/ech/transports (ws/grpc/xhttp/httpupgrade/http) and hysteria2 salamander obfs (endpoint_outbound.dart:155), but grep fragment|shadowtls|anytls|juicity|mieru in lib returns zero protocol hits — no fragment dialer option, no shadowtls/anytls outbound types, so clients of censored networks cannot configure the exact tricks goal.md freezes as ON.
findings.fix: Add fragment dialer fields (if fork accepts them) plus anytls/shadowtls outbound mapping in the ingestion adapter and the manual endpoint editor.

findings.title: Hotkeys, system tray, and qanatvpn:// deeplink absent on Windows — no background control surface
findings.evidence: goal.md section 11: "hotkeys/tray/deeplink"; intent.md 2.8: "Throne QHotkey, Karing qanatvpn:// | Yes, QHotkey + tray + qanatvpn://". Code: windows/runner contains only the Flutter boilerplate (main.cpp/win32_window.cpp — grep tray|hotkey matches only the sing-box.exe binary); runner.exe.manifest has no executable/deep-link registration; there is no qanatvpn:// intent-filter on Android and no deeplink handler in Dart. Desktop users must keep the window open to toggle the tunnel.
findings.fix: Add a system tray icon with connect/disconnect menu and RegisterHotKey shortcuts in the Windows runner (or via a tray plugin), plus qanatvpn:// protocol activation routed to the same provider calls.

findings.title: Diagnostics deep lock partial: no Prism HMAC, no per-hop traceroute, no DNS-leak scanner stages, no sort-by-ping in endpoint list
findings.evidence: goal.md section 15 deep: "Slipnet-like DNS scanner 0-6 + Prism HMAC + Simple Ping TCP 5000ms + sort by ping + ... PingRoute per-hop"; intent.md 2.8: "V2RayN Tcping vs Real ping ... | Yes, urltest + TCP ping + real-delay, observatory/leastPing balancer, sort by ping". Code: health.dart ships a 0-6 composite (hijack + single TCP ping, 5s timeout at health.dart:140) but grep prism|hmac returns zero hits and there is no traceroute/hop code anywhere; endpoints_screen.dart has no latency column or sort (grep latency|sort -> none) — latency sampling exists only inside urltest groups (latency.dart:110-132), so users cannot eyeball the fastest endpoint before connecting.
findings.fix: Add staged scanner probes (multi-resolver leak check), a per-hop route probe, endpoint-list latency sweep with sort control, and the Prism HMAC identity check to the diagnostics module.

findings.title: Per-app picker has no search/filter/sort and one shared selection across allowlist and bypass modes, unlike Karing and FlClash
findings.evidence: Competitor: Karing ships a searchable per-app screen with explicit modes — research/01-Karing.md:265-266 ('Whitelist Mode ON: only checked apps go through VPN ... Blacklist mode: checked apps bypass') and :607 ('Per-App proxy (whitelist/blacklist)'); FlClash added search specifically — research/11-FlClash.md:624-626 ('Optimize access control page (v0.8.91) → searchable list of installed apps / running processes with allow/block per-app', 'Add search function at access control (v0.8.17)'). App: _SplitStepState (lib/modules/onboarding/wizard.dart:294-352) renders a raw ListView.builder of CheckboxListTiles over listInstalledApps() results with zero filtering, zero search field, and selection s
findings.fix: Add a TextField filter above the list, show a selected-count chip, and reset/clearly restate the selection when allowMode toggles; add QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES (or per-target-SDK equivalent) so the picker is populated.

findings.title: Windows ships the Android-shaped wizard: fake grant/battery steps and a permanently empty per-app picker, while competitors have real desktop per-app UX
findings.evidence: Competitor: research/10-WireSock.md:504 — Secure Connect's profile wizard exposes split tunneling pickers on desktop ('Tunneled apps/networks lists with Browse file / Browse folder / Pick running process buttons'); research/02-Throne.md:182 documents Windows per-app via process rules ('include_interface/exclude_interface, process_path/process_name rules via route.find_process: true'). App: Windows main.dart:34-38 returns DesktopPlatformAdapter whose listInstalledApps() is 'const <InstalledApp>[]' (lib/core/services/desktop_platform_adapter.dart:38-39) and whose permission methods all return safe defaults (lines 11-20). So on the shipped Windows MVP the wizard forces the user through two mean
findings.fix: Platform-gate the wizard shape: on Windows show only the per-app step backed by a process-path picker (Throne/WireSock model) feeding process_name rules, or skip onboarding entirely for desktop MVP instead of showing dead Android steps.

findings.title: Dead 'Setup guide' tile and dead back() navigation: onboarding cannot be re-entered or backed out of after completion
findings.evidence: Competitor: the app's own prototype makes onboarding a re-runnable, fully navigable flow — docs/prototype-final.html:207-209 renders an 'Onboarding' bento tile with 'Start wizard' next to Diagnostics/Subscriptions, and :350 shows a live 'Step N/3' pill; competitors keep per-app config editable post-setup (research/01-Karing.md:265 'Settings -> TUN -> Proxy by Application' as a settings screen, not a one-time wizard). App: the wizard is only a shell-gate; once done, AppShell renders child forever (lib/app/app.dart:136-142) and WizardStep has no re-entry API. The bento grid's fourth tile is WizardTile (lib/modules/vpn/screens/home.dart:49) but its onTap is 'GoRouter.of(context).go('/home')' (l
findings.fix: Either re-point WizardTile to reset wizardProvider (making the gate re-runnable, matching the prototype tile) or remove it and the dead back() method; expose the split choice in a settings/rules surface for post-hoc editing.

findings.title: Mirror fallback silently drops the changelog to an empty string, so rate-limited or offline-first users see a changelog-less update card
findings.evidence: updater.dart:209-212 comment: 'Mirror format: {version, platforms: {key: {url, version}}}. No changelog in the mirror, so the changelog field stays empty and the API is retried on the next daily pass for the body.' UpdateSource.latestFor falls back to the mirror whenever the GitHub API throws (rate limit, offline), so the user is offered 'Update vX for android-arm64' with no reason to install, exactly on the flaky/censored networks this product targets. The gh-pages producer schema (updater.dart:216-240 latestJsonFromRelease) omits the body even though it has the full release object in hand.
findings.fix: Add the release body into the latest.json mirror schema (UpdateFetcher.latestJsonFromRelease already receives it) and parse it in _fromMirror; optionally fetch the body lazily on card open when missing.

findings.title: No release-channel choice (stable/beta): the checker only ever reads releases/latest, while Karing exposes a stable/beta switch and Clash Verge a Stable/AutoBuild channel table
findings.evidence: updater.dart:61-64 hardcodes `https://api.github.com/repos/$repository/releases/latest` (only the /latest endpoint, which excludes pre-releases by definition) and UpdateInfo.isNewerThan compares plain semver with no channel concept; grep for beta|prerelease|channel in lib/modules/updates returns nothing. Competitors: research/01-Karing.md:663 'Android: https://karing.app/download (stable/beta switch)'; research/12-Clash-Verge-Rev.md:890-900 channel table ('Stable ... AutoBuild — rolling canary, best for bug reporters') with Settings→About showing the channel; research/06-V2RayNG.md:4 ships '2.3.6 (2026-08-29 pre-release)' alongside stable 2.2.6.
findings.fix: Add a persisted channel setting (stable|beta) that switches the endpoint to /releases (filtering prerelease:true and picking the newest) and include the channel tag in the version comparison.

findings.title: Geo/SRS asset updates are fully invisible: refreshAll runs silently with no settings surface, no last-updated status, no manual refresh, no per-asset state — competitors all ship a geo-assets settings page
findings.evidence: main.dart:143-174 _seedGeoAssets and lib/modules/geo/geo_asset.dart:165-191 refreshAll run headless: on failure they `continue;` silently and keep stale bytes; nothing in lib/modules/geo or diagnostics exposes which asset version/date is live, whether the last refresh hit the 60/hr raw.githubusercontent limit, or a manual 'update now' affordance. Competitors surface this: research/03-NekoBox-Android.md:237 'NekoBox UI: Settings → Route → Geo Assets downloads geoip.db/geosite.db'; research/04-Nekoray.md:389 'Preferences → Basic Settings → Update Assets or toolbar Xray Assets Updater'; research/06-V2RayNG.md:294 'Settings Update Geo assets downloads enhanced version'. The audit explicitly scop
findings.fix: Add a geo assets card (per-tag: URL, cached bytes date, last refresh result, rate-limit reset countdown, refresh button) fed by GeoAsset metadata (persist checkedAt/etag per tag next to the .srs files).

findings.title: Failure UX is a raw exception string: rate-limit signals are parsed into typed exceptions but surfaced as error.toString() in a plain card, with no retry-after guidance
findings.evidence: The controller deliberately decodes GitHubRateLimitException(resetAt) and RateLimitException(retryAfter) (updater.dart:69-83) but checkNow ends with the generic `state = UpdateFailed(error.toString())` (updates_controller.dart:124); the screen renders it verbatim in _MessageCard (updates_screen.dart:52-54) — the user sees Dart toString text like 'GitHubRateLimitException' with no wait time or retry hint, and there is no 'retry at' scheduling in the UI. Competitor research/01-Karing.md:523 wraps the update flow with `sentry_flutter` dialog UX.
findings.fix: Map the two rate-limit exceptions to localized, human-readable failure states carrying resetAt/retryAfter (e.g. 'Rate limited — retrying after 14:32 UTC'), and disable the Check-now button until reset.

findings.title: Last-checked time is shown as a raw ISO-8601 UTC string instead of a localized relative time, and the Updates screen header/labels are hardcoded English outside the ARB
findings.evidence: updates_screen.dart:35 `lastCheckedAt?.toIso8601String()` renders e.g. '2026-09-04T07:12:33.481Z' as the entire card text for the UpdateIdle state, bypassing the app's own l10n (the neighboring branch uses l10n?.updatesIdle). goal.md section 15 locks 'i18n/RTL/a11y EN + FA RTL + ARB' and the code style rules require localized, sentence-case strings (AGENTS.md Code style). Same screen hardcodes 'Updates' (:29), 'Update v${info.version} for ${info.platformKey}' (:94) and 'Download & install' (:112) outside the ARB.
findings.fix: Format via intl relative time (e.g. 'Checked 2 hours ago') with locale awareness, and move the four hardcoded strings into app_en.arb/app_fa.arb.

findings.title: No metered-network guard on update downloads: the daily background check and the install download run on any connected network including mobile data
findings.evidence: main.dart:126-131 registerPeriodicTask uses Constraints(networkType: NetworkType.connected) — any connection counts, and checkNow/on-demand download adds no connectivity test; on Windows the same card triggers a download with no awareness of the active interface. research/09-WG-Tunnel.md:249 documents competitor network-type gating for tunnel actions ('Tunnel on Wi-Fi ... Tunnel on Mobile Data'); v2rayNG marks its VPN setMetered(false) so the OS metering hints exist in the ecosystem (research/06-V2RayNG.md:312). For an app whose audience is metered mobile data in censored regions, a 24h poll is fine but a multi-MB APK pull over cellular with no warning is a felt gap.
findings.fix: Keep the 24h metadata check on any network, but gate the actual asset download behind an unmetered check (Connectivity/NetworkCapabilities on Android; Windows NLM or user setting) with an explicit 'download over mobile data anyway' confirm.

findings.title: Blocked state is a dead end: one-line reason with no retry hint, no logs link, no liveRegion, and 'no network' never maps to any state
findings.evidence: Competitor: research/09-WG-Tunnel.md:294-297 — health LEDs derive the reason from concrete log lines ('handshake did not complete after 5 seconds') so the user sees the true cause. App: home.dart:161-166 renders 'vpn.blockReason!.label(l10n)' as plain Text with no Semantics (the liveRegion pattern used on the endpoints screen is absent) and no CTA; the PowerTile does allow tap-to-retry (only connecting/disconnecting disable onTap) but nothing says so. There is no connectivity check anywhere in lib/ (only Android airplane mode at tunnel.dart:285-303; grep for connectivity/network_reachability finds no wiring, and DesktopPlatformAdapter.isAirplaneMode is a const false), so an offline connect s
findings.fix: Add a 'Retry' + 'View logs' action to the blocked StateTile, wrap the reason in Semantics(liveRegion: true), and add a lightweight connectivity pre-check mapped to a dedicated 'No network' block reason instead of folding offline into establishFailed.

findings.title: AWG profile editor — the star protocol surface — is entirely hardcoded English including its 'Validation errors' card
findings.evidence: Competitor: research/09-WG-Tunnel.md:40 — WG-Tunnel localizes its full AmneziaWG settings card via Weblate/Crowdin. App: awg_profile_screen.dart:84-160 hardcodes 'New AWG profile', 'Tag', 'Private key (32-byte base64)', 'Peer endpoint', 'Tunnel addresses', 'MTU', 'Validation errors' (:135), 'Advanced obfuscation', 'Save', 'Cancel' — app_en.arb has no AWG keys at all (only endpointsAwgProfile for the entry button). goal.md §4 freezes 'WG + AmneziaWG (all values...) implemented first' as the differentiator and §15 freezes EN+FA; an Iranian user setting up the headline protocol works entirely in English and gets English-only invariant errors like the S1+56≠S2 card.
findings.fix: Add ARB keys for the editor (title, field labels, preset names, validation header) and localized validation messages from AwgConfig.validate.

findings.title: Routing compiler validation bodies are English dev-speak shown under a localized 'Validation errors' header
findings.evidence: Competitor: research/12-Clash-Verge-Rev.md:788 — Verge's Monaco editor gives schema 'diagnostics for reality-opts missing public-key' with human-readable messages. App: routing_compiler.dart:20,60,77-117,338,477,534 accumulate errors like 'policy: defaultOutbound is required', 'tor chain: socks port out of range 1-65535: 0', 'group 1 (x): selector/urltest needs at least 1 member', 'rule 2: ports must be "min:max" (min<max ≤65535): 80-90' — rendered verbatim in rules_screen.dart:107-111 and groups_screen.dart:114-117 under the localized header l10n.rulesValidationErrors/groupsValidationErrors. goal.md §6 freezes the 30-field editor as a core capability; for the FA-RTL audience (the second loc
findings.fix: Introduce error codes with parameters (e.g. portsNotMinMax: {rule},{raw}) and resolve them to localized templates at render time in the rules/groups screens, keeping the compiler platform-pure.

findings.title: Error presentation is inconsistent within the same screens: persistent inline text vs auto-dismissing snackbars vs static tile text
findings.evidence: Competitor: research/12-Clash-Verge-Rev.md:283,318,363 — every failure class ('red dot + error toast via showNotice', 'red indicator + error message shown, changes skipped', 'showNotice toast with line number + error; Profiles card turns red; core keeps running old config') flows through one notice channel with a consistent visual model. App: on the SAME Endpoints screen, URL-import errors are persistent inline red text with Semantics liveRegion (endpoints_screen.dart:88-100) while backup import/export failures are transient default snackbars (:163-170,:182,:229) that vanish after ~4s and are invisible to TalkBack; update-install errors are snackbars (updates_screen.dart:137), update-check f
findings.fix: Define one error-presentation rule (persistent inline/banner for blocking failures that need action, snackbar only for transient confirmations like export success), plus a shared ErrorBanner widget that always sets Semantics(liveRegion: true).

findings.title: Windows command-line arguments are collected by the runner but dropped: main() accepts no args and nothing reads dart entrypoint arguments
findings.evidence: Throne supports 'Bulk import via... CLI arg' (research/02-Throne.md:196), the standard headless-automation path for desktop VPN clients. App: the plumbing half-exists - main.cpp does 'project.set_dart_entrypoint_arguments(std::move(command_line_arguments));' (windows/runner/main.cpp:25) after GetCommandLineArguments() (utils.cpp:24) - but Dart's entrypoint is 'Future<void> main() async {' with no parameter list (lib/main.dart:42) and grep for dartEntryPointArguments/entrypoint arguments in lib/ returns nothing, so any 'qanatvpn.exe --import <url>' argument is silently discarded.
findings.fix: Change the entrypoint to Future<void> main(List<String> args), detect flags like --import <url-or-path> / --connect <tag>, and dispatch to EndpointsController.importText or the tunnel notifier before the first frame.

findings.title: No one-tap clipboard import button or clipboard monitor: paste is possible only by manually typing into the import TextField
findings.evidence: V2RayNG: 'MainActivity -> Import from Clipboard -> Utils.getClipboard() -> AngConfigManager.importBatchConfig() handles single URI or base64 batch' (research/06-V2RayNG.md:265); Hiddify: 'Home -> + -> Add from clipboard (auto-detects...)' (research/07-Hiddify.md:194); Throne: 'Ctrl+V on main window reads clipboard (share link / JSON / Clash / throne://) -> GroupUpdater imports' (research/02-Throne.md:364); Karing runs a background 'clipboard monitor (lib/app/utils/clipboard_utils.dart)' (research/01-Karing.md:406). App: grep for 'Clipboard' across lib/ and test/ returns zero matches - no Clipboard.getData call exists. The only import UX is the _ImportBox TextField where the user must long-pr
findings.fix: Add a paste-from-clipboard icon button next to Import (services.Clipboard.getData('text/plain') -> importText) and consider an opt-in clipboard sniff on app resume offering one-tap add when a recognized scheme is present.

findings.title: No Quick Settings tile and no action on the foreground notification: lock-screen toggling is impossible
findings.evidence: Competitor side: research/01-Karing.md:607 'Quick Settings TileService (android/app/src/main/kotlin/com/nebula/karing/TileService.kt:63), foreground VpnService notification with disconnect button'; research/03-NekoBox-Android.md:474-476 QuickToggleTileService tap toggles VPN; research/06-V2RayNG.md:444 tile states synced with CoreServiceManager.isRunning. App side: android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml declares only .ForegroundService and .QanatVpnService (no TileService, no BIND_QUICK_SETTINGS_TILE), and ForegroundService.kt buildNotification renders a static ongoing 'Tunnel active' notification with no addAction. Every toggle requires unlock → find app → tap; there is no shade-level cont
findings.fix: Add a TileService that toggles via a start-service/stop intent, and add connect/disconnect actions to the foreground notification with state updates from the engine event sink.

findings.title: No QR scan, no vless://-style deeplink, no share-target import: daily node sharing means manual copy-paste
findings.evidence: Competitor side: goal.md §9 locks 'QR/ZIP deeplink' for subscriptions, and research/07-Hiddify.md:52 ships 'app_links 6.4.0 + win32 5.12.0 (deep links/URL scheme)' for exactly this. App side: android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml MainActivity has only the MAIN/LAUNCHER intent-filter (plus a PROCESS_TEXT query) — no VIEW/BROWSABLE for vless://-style links; endpoints_screen.dart _ImportBox is a paste-only TextField with an import button; no QR/scan dependency exists in pubspec.yaml. Importing a node from a chat or QR code on the phone screen requires copy → switch app → paste, every time a new node is shared.
findings.fix: Register VIEW/BROWSABLE intent filters for the share-link schemes (and a plain text share target), then route them into EndpointsController.importText; add QR scan for on-screen codes.

findings.title: No pre-connect refresh cadence: engine urltest interval only applies after connect; on-device latency state is in-memory only
findings.evidence: Competitor: research/07-Hiddify.md:235 'core runs urltest outbound group ... probing cp.cloudflare.com ... best latency wins'; research/03-NekoBox-Android.md:452 'Results cached per entity. Bulk test via WorkManager coroutine.' App: profile_config_source.dart:300-313 does emit the urltest group with url/interval ('type': 'urltest', 'url': group.url, 'interval': _formatDuration) so the ENGINE self-tests while connected, but LatencyController (latency.dart:74-76) only builds const LatencyState() with zero samples, refresh() is called solely from the Groups screen speed icon (groups_screen.dart:36-37), grep for Timer/periodic in latency.dart and groups_screen.dart returns nothing, and LatencySt
findings.fix: Run a sweep on endpoints import, after app start (post startup), and optionally on a periodic timer while the app is alive; persist last samples so badges survive restarts.

findings.title: No failed-reachability state or color coding for latency results
findings.evidence: Competitor: research/05-V2RayN.md:437 'UI column Latency shows ms (color: green <150, yellow 150-300, red >300, -1 fail)'. App: LatencyReport is Map<String, int?> and groups_screen.dart:132-143 _bestMsSuffix prints ' · best $best ms' with no threshold logic, and there is no distinct UI state for 'never measured' vs 'unreachable' — both render as an absent suffix; goal.md:111 even locks 'Simple Ping TCP 5000ms + sort by ping' for diagnostics, but the sweep's null results are indistinguishable from untested ones in the UI.
findings.fix: Color-code badges by threshold bands (green/amber/red) and render failed probes distinctly (e.g. dash or error tint) so dead endpoints are visible at a glance.

findings.title: goal.md section 11 lifecycle affordances absent: no tray, no hotkeys, no deeplink — and no settings screen exists to host any of them
findings.evidence: goal.md:79 (section 11): 'Extra Features — ALL DAY 1 ... hotkeys/tray/deeplink'. Competitors: research/02-Throne.md:38 GUI 'owns: ... hotkeys, tray'; research/07-Hiddify.md:396: 'tray_manager 0.5.0 ... desktop tray icon states connected/disconnected/dark'; research/12-Clash-Verge-Rev.md:745 tray switch. App: grep for tray/hotkey/deeplink in lib/ and windows/runner returns nothing; AndroidManifest.xml declares only MAIN/LAUNCHER intent-filters (lines 31-34, 44-46) — no VIEW/scheme filter, so qanatvpn:// links cannot reach the app; the router (lib/app/app.dart:35-74) has no settings route at all, so even if the seams existed there is no in-app surface to toggle any lifecycle behavior.
findings.fix: Ship the goal's day-1 slice: a tray icon on Windows with connect/disconnect/endpoint-switch menu and a global hotkey, a VIEW intent-filter for qanatvpn:// actions, and a /settings screen hosting boot-start, auto-reconnect, always-on link, and notification preferences.

findings.title: No connections page — no per-flow view of matched rule, proxy chain, or close action
findings.evidence: FlClash polls 'GET /connections' every ~1s showing 'src → dst, domain, process, rule, proxy chain, upload/download, duration' with 'Close single conn, Close all' (research/11-FlClash.md §9); Verge's Connections page lists the same columns and 'DELETE /connections/:id' (research/12-Clash-Verge-Rev.md:726-727). The app has only a raw log stream: logs_screen.dart renders parsed EngineLogLine text from LogBus, and grep for 'connections' across lib/ matches nothing behavioral; the engine event surface is 'enum BoxEventKind { started, stopped, crashed }' (tunnel.dart:94). Users cannot see which app/domain went through which node or kill a hung flow — power-user visibility that all four Clash/v2ray
findings.fix: Expose the clash-api connections endpoint (the vendored fork is built with_clash_api) through the platform adapters into a connections tab with per-flow rule/chain/updown and close actions.

findings.title: No custom User-Agent / request headers for subscription fetch — provider gating unhandled
findings.evidence: v2rayNG exposes 'Custom HTTP headers JSON textarea → SubscriptionItem.requestHeaders' plus an editable 'userAgent' field defaulting to 'v2rayNG/<version>' (research/06-V2RayNG.md §5 'Custom headers & User-Agent (2.3.x)'), because, as Exclave documents, 'Some airports selectively provide based on User-Agent, hence customizable UA' (research/08-Exclave.md:262). The app sends only 'plainFetch(maybeUrl, const <String, String>{'Accept': "'*/*'"})' (endpoints_controller.dart:96-98) — no User-Agent at all and no way to add Authorization/X-hwid headers that Marzban/3x-ui panels require, so header-gated subscriptions fail or return HTML with no workaround.
findings.fix: Send a 'QANATVPN/<version>' User-Agent by default and let the user attach per-source custom headers (JSON) stored alongside the subscription source, passed into plainFetch.

findings.title: Ingestion is one paste box: no QR scan, no file/ZIP import, no deeplink scheme despite frozen locks
findings.evidence: goal.md §9 (FROZEN): 'Subscriptions: All formats + ETag 24h + QR/ZIP deeplink'; intent.md extra-features lock: 'Hotkeys/tray/deeplink | Throne QHotkey, Karing qanatvpn:// | Yes, QHotkey + tray + qanatvpn://'. Competitors: research/06-V2RayNG.md:264-266 'Import paths — clipboard / QR / file / manual'; research/01-Karing.md:381 'Add Profiles — supports: paste URL, paste content, scan QR, import from file, import ZIP'; research/02-Throne.md:413 'Multiple file selection for importing from file'. In this app lib/modules/vpn/repositories/endpoints_screen.dart:263-330 _ImportBox is a single 3-line TextField + Import button; FilePicker appears only in the backup export/import flow (.qnv, endpoints_scr
findings.fix: Add file import (route picked text through the existing IngestionAdapter content sniffer) and a share-in intent for vless/vmess/ss/trojan/https subscription URIs; QR scan can follow via mobile_scanner, all feeding the already-built importText pipeline.

findings.title: No rename: StoredEndpoint.label is a dead field promised by the model but never editable
findings.evidence: Competitors expose rename everywhere: research/13-Matsuri-SagerNet.md:387 'create/rename/delete group, move profile between groups (drag-sort via ItemTouchHelper), copy/share profile (long-press → QR or clipboard URI)'. The app's StoredEndpoint.label is explicitly 'Editor-facing name; defaults to the endpoint's tag' (lib/modules/vpn/repositories/endpoint_store.dart:78-85) but is never written by any UI — import sets label: endpoint.tag (endpoints_controller.dart:141/175) and the list tile just displays it (endpoints_screen.dart:96). A 40-node subscription full of provider-generated remarks like 'IEPL-HK-01 [半月]' cannot be renamed to anything readable.
findings.fix: Add a rename action (long-press menu or detail sheet) calling a new controller rename(tag, label) that rewrites StoredEndpoint.label only — tags stay stable so groups referencing them don't break.

findings.title: Group member picker has no search/filter/regex — checkbox wall at subscription scale, and the locked sing-box filter field is unimplemented
findings.evidence: goal.md §6 (FROZEN): 'Groups: sing-box 3-tier (auto urltest → selector → proxy) with filter'. Competitors already use regex member filters: research/05-V2RayN.md:316 policy group example 'policygroup with ChildItems... Filter:"example" regex'. In this app lib/modules/routing/routing_policy.dart:38-62 OutboundGroup has no filter field at all, and groups_screen.dart:262-270 _GroupFormSheet renders one CheckboxListTile per known tag — importing a 200-node subscription makes the sheet 200 undifferentiated checkboxes with no search, and the compiler can never emit sing-box's filter include/exclude, so a 'HK only' urltest must be hand-ticked from 200 rows.
findings.fix: Add filterRegex/include/exclude fields to OutboundGroup, render them in the form sheet, and have the compiler expand them over leaf tags into members (or emit the fork's group filter) — compiler + form changes only.

findings.title: ETag infrastructure exists but is never used for subscriptions (goal promised ETag 24h for subs)
findings.evidence: Goal: goal.md:70-72 'All formats + ETag 24h + QR/ZIP deeplink' and :126 'Parsers + daily ETag (6h cache)'. App: lib/core/network/http_cache.dart:7-9 'Rate-limit / ETag aware HTTP cache ... If-None-Match revalidation' with If-None-Match at :47-48 — its only consumer is GeoAsset (main.dart:150-170 _seedGeoAssets; geo_asset.dart:13-14 'refreshAll() is ETag-aware with a 6h ...'), while sub import deliberately uses 'Plain HTTP fetch with no cache semantics' (plain_fetch.dart:7-8) with no conditional headers (endpoints_controller.dart:96-98 const {'Accept': '*/*'}); grep If-None-Match in lib/ matches only http_cache.dart and geo_asset.dart. Competitor: research/07-Hiddify.md:371 'fetch via dio ...
findings.fix: Route subscription fetches through HttpCache (already disk-backed and ETag-aware) so restarts keep their validator and 304s skip parse — the component exists and needs only to be wired into the sub refresher.

findings.title: Sub fetch sends fixed Accept header only: no User-Agent, no per-sub custom headers, no content-type capture
findings.evidence: Competitors: research/06-V2RayNG.md:261 'SubEditActivity exposes Custom HTTP headers JSON textarea → SubscriptionItem.requestHeaders ... Useful for HWID-locked panels (Marzban, 3x-ui). userAgent field defaults to v2rayNG/<version> but editable'; research/08-Exclave.md:267-275 'User-Agent spoofing (airport anti-bot): ... Some airports selectively provide based on User-Agent, hence customizable UA' with a per-sub UA override table. App: endpoints_controller.dart:96-98 'plainFetch(maybeUrl, const <String, String>{'Accept': '*/*'})' — no User-Agent, no custom headers; plain_fetch.dart:15-20 sets only connectionTimeout and caller headers; and RawSubscription.contentType is declared (ingestion_ada
findings.fix: Send a default 'User-Agent: qanatvpn/<version>', allow per-sub custom UA + header JSON stored on the Subscription record, and pass response content-type into RawSubscription.contentType for more reliable format dispatch.

findings.title: No QR / ZIP / custom-scheme deeplink import: goal's 'QR/ZIP deeplink' and the prototype's subscriptions page are unimplemented
findings.evidence: Goal: goal.md:70-72 'QR/ZIP deeplink' and docs/prototype-final.html:313-329 Profiles page: 'ETag 24h, 6h cache, QR/ZIP deeplink qanatvpn://' with per-row QR / Export ZIP buttons and a Subscriptions nav entry. Competitors: research/01-Karing.md:388-390 'clash:// ... sing-box://' scheme import; research/07-Hiddify.md:34 'imports them via hiddify://import/..., clipboard, QR'; research/05-V2RayN.md:458 'Scan QR Code from Screen ... decodes QR ... auto Add Batch Servers'. App: AndroidManifest.xml:31-46 MainActivity has only MAIN/LAUNCHER and the VpnService intent-filter (no VIEW/BROWSABLE scheme); pubspec.yaml:12-34 contains no scanner or app_links/deeplink package; grep for qr/deeplink/zip handli
findings.fix: Add a VIEW/BROWSABLE intent-filter for qanatvpn:// (and optionally clash:// sing-box:// vless:// pass-through) plus a qr-scanner package, routing decoded payloads straight into EndpointsController.importText; add ZIP export of WG INI bundles for share.

findings.title: Subscription fetch is always direct: cannot update subs through the tunnel or a front proxy on censored networks
findings.evidence: Competitors: research/01-Karing.md:404 'Prioritize proxy download configuration: When the connection is turned on, prioritize [Current Selection] to download/update configuration ... to bypass GFW; otherwise direct'; research/05-V2RayN.md:264 'Fetch via SubHandler.UpdateSub() with HttpClient (honors PreSocksPort if update via proxy enabled ...)'. App: plain_fetch.dart:15-19 creates a bare 'HttpClient()..connectionTimeout = const Duration(seconds: 15)' and 'client.getUrl(url)' with no proxy/detour parameter anywhere; endpoints_controller.dart:96 calls it directly. On the app's own target network (goal.md:1 'User: Public in censored regions'), a blocked sub host means the import box spins for
findings.fix: Add an optional fetch-via-proxy mode that, when the tunnel is connected, sends the sub request through the engine's local mixed/SOCKS inbound (goal.md:7 already promises 'Local SOCKS5 10808'), with a fallback to direct when disconnected.

findings.title: Stored endpoints cannot be edited or re-exported as .conf
findings.evidence: research/09-WG-Tunnel.md §7: 'Export → single .conf or ZIP (all tunnels) via FileProvider' and full manual-entry editor for stored tunnels. App: endpoints_screen.dart:121-146 builds each stored endpoint as 'Card > ListTile' with only a delete action ('tooltip: '${l10n.endpointsDelete} ${stored.label}' ... .delete(index)'); the only export is encrypted whole-store backup 'BackupService().exportBytes(password)' producing .qnv — no wg INI rendering, no tag re-edit, so a profile typed into the AWG sheet is locked in.
findings.fix: Add per-endpoint edit (reopen stored values in the AWG sheet) and share/export actions producing wg-quick INI (with AWG keys) or a QR, mirroring the importer's WgIniParser shape.

findings.title: No file-picker or ZIP multi-config import path
findings.evidence: research/09-WG-Tunnel.md §7: '.conf Files — SAF file picker *.conf → WireGuardConfigParser ... ZIP Archives — import multiple tunnels at once (skip duplicates)'. App: ingestion_adapter.dart:25 'Dispatch is content-sniffed: wg INI, clash YAML, sing-box/SIP008 JSON, then' share-links — accepts one pasted string only; FilePicker in endpoints_screen.dart is used solely for .qnv backup restore (line 169 'allowedExtensions: const <String>['qnv']'); docs/prototype-final.html:314 promises 'QR/ZIP deeplink qanatvpn://'.
findings.fix: Add a pick-file action (type any, plus .zip) that reads bytes and feeds the existing content-sniffing adapter, expanding ZIP entries through the same parsers.

findings.title: No per-endpoint latency or handshake health indicator; health ping is a single fixed global probe
findings.evidence: research/09-WG-Tunnel.md §6: 'LED indicator: green=healthy, red=unhealthy, gray=unknown ... hierarchical: Logs Check → Ping Check → Stats Check' per tunnel plus 'Tunnel Ping Interval default 30s ... Custom Ping Targets per-tunnel map'. App: endpoint list subtitle shows only ''${_protocolName(stored)} · ${stored.sourceUrl ?? 'manual'}'' (endpoints_screen.dart:124-130); the health module is one global probe — diagnostics_screen.dart:59 'title: 'Ping (TCP 1.1.1.1:443)'' with fixed target, no per-endpoint latency, no handshake staleness, no interval/target settings.
findings.fix: Add per-endpoint TCP ping (reuse TcpPinger against each peer endpoint) with a latency pill in the list and selectable ping interval/targets; drive a green/gray indicator from the existing log-stream FATAL scan.

findings.title: Per-app split is wizard-only: no revisit/edit UI after onboarding, and nothing on Windows
findings.evidence: research/09-WG-Tunnel.md §4: 'Split Tunneling UI lists installed apps ... Include mode (addAllowedApplication) / Exclude mode ... Global Split Tunneling setting applies to all tunnels'; research/10-WireSock.md §4 documents global vs per-profile split with override. App: split_store.dart:6 '/// The user's per-app split decision from the wizard step 3.' — SplitChoice is written once at wizard finish (wizard.dart:107 'SplitChoice(allowMode: state.allowMode, packages: state.selectedApps)'); grep allowMode|toggleApp|selectedApps outside wizard matches only split_store.dart and profile_config_source.dart — no screen reads or writes it afterwards, so fixing a wrong selection means re-running onboar
findings.fix: Extract the wizard's app-picker step into a standalone screen (allowlist/bypass SegmentedButton + checkbox list) reachable from home, reading and writing SplitStore directly.

findings.title: Config edits while connected are ignored — no hot-reload path despite startOrReloadService existing
findings.evidence: NekoBox regenerates and reapplies config on 'profile switch' and store edits (research/04-Nekoray.md §8: 'Call sites: main/main.cpp on Start, ui/mainwindow.cpp on profile switch, sub/speedtest.cpp on test'), with a persistent daemon architecture. App: Tunnel.connect bails if 'if (_state == TunnelState.connecting || _state == TunnelState.connected) return;' (tunnel.dart:236), so editing a rule/group/endpoint while connected only writes the store; the channel has startOrReloadService plumbing ('channel blocks until Go's startOrReloadService returns', channel_adapters.dart:13) but no Dart path calls it outside the full stop/start cycle — users must manually disconnect, save, reconnect to apply
findings.fix: Add Tunnel.reload(tag) that re-resolves the config (cache already fingerprinted in profile_config_source.dart) and invokes startOrReloadService while connected, with a blocked-on-failure fallback.

findings.title: No live connections/requests list or traffic stats — the NekoBox class's core observability surface is absent
findings.evidence: NekoBox Android ships the yacd dashboard at 'http://127.0.0.1:9090/ui' and per-outbound uplink/downlink stats via clash_api (research/03-NekoBox-Android.md §10); goal.md §11 locks 'Groups, stats, backup... logs/requests/connections'. App: the fork was built with with_clash_api (AGENTS.md build tags) but grep for 'clash_api|9090|experimental' across lib/ returns zero results; the only runtime visibility is LogBus text lines ('_logBus.add(EngineLogLine.parse(message))', channel_adapters.dart:41) and the diagnostics screen's single health probe (diagnostics_screen.dart 'live 0-6 health score, DNS hijack state, TCP ping'), so a user cannot see which app/connection is burning traffic or what rout
findings.fix: Enable clash_api in the generated config, poll connections/stats into a Connections tab (live rows + totals), reusing the existing diagnostics tab shell.

findings.title: Manual per-protocol endpoint editor exists only for AWG — the 6 proxy protocols are paste-only, no editing
findings.evidence: NekoBox: 'New Profile → Type dropdown lets manual creation for any protocol without subscription: pick protocol, fill host/port/uuid/cipher/network/tls, save' (research/04-Nekoray.md §4). App: the only manual editor is the AWG one ('_openAwgEditor(BuildContext context)' → awg_profile_screen.dart); on the endpoints list every row's only affordance is the delete icon ('trailing: Semantics(... icon: const Icon(Icons.delete_outline), onPressed: ... delete(index))', endpoints_screen.dart:102). For VLESS+Reality/Vision, Hysteria2 obfs, TUIC, or SSH-key params not expressible in the share link, the user has no way to fix or enter them in-app.
findings.fix: Add a generic protocol editor (protocol dropdown → typed fields per NormalizedEndpoint variant, persisted via the existing saveManual path) reachable from each endpoints row.

findings.title: No share/export per node, no clipboard-import deeplink, no QR import — interop with the ecosystem's share flows is one-way
findings.evidence: NekoBox: 'Right-click → Share generates vmess://... for export; QR scan share: ZXing-lite Camera → parse link → add entity' (research/04-Nekoray.md §4, research/03-NekoBox-Android.md §10). App: AndroidManifest.xml registers only the LAUNCHER intent ('<category android:name="android.intent.category.LAUNCHER"/>' at lines 31-34, no VIEW/scheme filter); grep for QR/qrcode/share-out in lib/ finds only the encrypted backup export and the PROCESS_TEXT paste hook — no deeplink handler, no QR generation for the selected endpoint, no per-node link copy.

findings.title: DNS is a fixed code constant: no DNS editor, no direct-DNS domain lists beyond hardcoded geosite-cn, FakeIP filters silently dropped
findings.evidence: NekoBox: DNS routing uses separate remote/direct server lists ('domainListDNSRemote → dns-remote, domainListDNSDirect → dns-direct', research/04-Nekoray.md §7) plus 'Use DNS Object → textarea dns_object (full sing-box dns JSON)' escape hatch. NekoBox Android exposes DNS strategy/disable_cache/client_subnet etc. (research/03-NekoBox-Android.md §9). App: DnsConfig is a const with fixed defaults ('this.dohServer = 1.1.1.1', dns_config.dart:12) and toDnsJson always hardcodes {'rule_set': ['geosite-cn'], 'server': 'dns-local'} — no UI screen edits DNS at all; the comment at dns_config.dart:43-48 admits fake_ip_filter is dead data ('any fake_ip_filter key FATALs sing-box check. Filters stay Dart-s
findings.fix: Add a DNS editor (DoH server/path, direct server, strategy, per-rule geosite lists) writing into DnsConfig, and either grow the fork's fakeip schema for filters or document their absence.

findings.title: Stats tile shows connect-phase milliseconds, not throughput: no live traffic counters anywhere in the UI or notification
findings.evidence: The goal froze 'Groups, stats, backup/WebDAV+LAN ZIP, observatory leastPing ... logs/requests/connections' (goal.md §11) and V2RayNG shows '↑↓ MB/s' live in the notification (research/06-V2RayNG.md:448). The app's StatsTile renders 'connect ${metrics.total.inMilliseconds} ms' plus phase keys 'grant/box/config' (home.dart:272-281), and the traffic source is stubbed: 'override fun writeConnectionEvents(events: ConnectionEvents?) {}' (BoxEngine.kt:166) with no QueryStats/throughput anywhere in lib/ (grep rxBytes/throughput/QueryStats: no hits). Daily 'is my VPN actually passing traffic and how fast?' has no answer in the UI.
findings.fix: Wire CommandClient log/status or libbox QueryStats through BoxEngine to a throughput stream, replace the StatsTile headline with live up/down rates, and mirror them into the foreground notification.

findings.title: No connections/requests view — user cannot see which outbound (PROXY/DIRECT/REJECT) handled a domain while debugging rules
findings.evidence: research/02-Throne.md:373: 'Connections tab: live TCP/UDP conns with inbound/outbound, process, domain, speed, duration — sortable'; research/12-Clash-Verge-Rev.md:100-103 documents the connections plane Verge renders; the project's own prototype lists Connections/Requests/DNS-queries tiles as part of the Logs page (docs/prototype-final.html:276-280) and goal.md:11 freezes 'logs/requests/connections' as day-1 extras. The app has none: grep for 'Connections' across lib/ matches only interrupt_exist_connections (routing_policy.dart:61), the router registers just /home /groups /endpoints /rules /logs /diagnostics /updates (app/app.dart:35-66), and no screen shows which outbound a connection too

findings.title: Engine log level hardcoded to 'info' — no debug toggle for diagnosing handshake/routing failures
findings.evidence: research/12-Clash-Verge-Rev.md:732-734: 'Verge Logs page: streaming GET /logs?level=info (SSE); filter info|warning|error|debug|silent ... debug level is very verbose (packet-level TUN debug)'. The app hardcodes the engine log level in the generated config: config_assembler.dart:67 writes 'log': {'level': 'info'}, grep for logLevel/log_level/Level.debug across lib/ finds nothing, and the Logs screen offers only an all/errors content filter (log_bus.dart:86 isError = ERROR||FATAL). Handshake and routing failures in censored networks routinely need DEBUG lines (e.g. reality/uTLS negotiation detail); the user cannot reproduce what support asks for.
findings.fix: Add a debug-logging toggle (settings tile) that swaps the 'log' block level to 'debug' before assemble and warns about verbosity, mirroring Verge's level filter; keep default info.

findings.title: Update install failures show error.toString() raw, including internal classes like UnsupportedError('no installer for windows')
findings.evidence: Competitor side: research/12-Clash-Verge-Rev.md:577 maps spawn failure to an actionable instruction ('Insufficient privileges → Install Service Mode or run as administrator'). App side: updates_screen.dart:126-135 catches 'on Object catch (error)' and shows 'SnackBar(content: Text(error.toString()))' — for an APK download the raw MethodChannel 'install_failed …' code/message, or on Windows 'Bad state: no installer for windows' from the UnsupportedError at line 131; the daily background task (updater.dart:378-380) additionally swallows all failures by returning false with no user-visible record at all.
findings.fix: Translate install failures ('Download failed — tap to retry', 'Installer unavailable on this device') and record background-task failures into the update store so the Updates screen shows why the last daily check failed.

findings.title: No recovery action attached to any failure state: VPN-permission-denied block requires the user to re-run the whole wizard to re-request

findings.title: No pre-connect network check: connecting with no internet ends in a 30s engine timeout mislabeled 'Engine failed to start'
findings.evidence: Competitor side: research/12-Clash-Verge-Rev.md:815 surfaces an actionable toast on service errors with a 'Restart Service' button, and V2RayNG/Throne show connectivity state immediately. App side: Tunnel.connect checks airplane but has no connectivity check; a dead network only fails at box.start with the 30s ceiling (tunnel.dart:432 timeout → _block(TunnelBlockReason.boxStartFailed)) — so the user stares at 'Connecting…' for up to 30s and then sees 'Engine failed to start' (blockBoxStartFailed label) for what is really no-network. Also no code path ever emits TunnelState.reconnecting (tunnel.dart:11 only), yet the UI ships the 'Reconnecting…' state (app_en.arb:35) — auto-retry/reconnect UX
findings.fix: Add a cheap reachability preflight (the TCP pinger from modules/routing/latency.dart already exists) before box.start and map failure to a dedicated 'No network' block reason; wire an auto-reconnect that emits the reconnecting state.

findings.fix: Define one error presentation rule (transient → snackbar, blocking → inline card with icon + action, validation → field-level) and a shared ErrorBanner widget used by all screens; localize everything that flows through it.

The controller also silently

Auto-failover on node death and sharing a filtered subset across many nodes are
findings.fix: Add OutboundGroup.fallback (sing-box fallback type: primary + fallback members + url probing) and a filter field (regex over leafOutbounds) to selector/urltest per the goal's '3-tier with filter' lock; compile both in RoutingCompiler.

findings.fix: Add an Android Quick Settings TileService bound to VpnNotifier state and RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED restore-last-state; on Windows integrate tray_manager + launch_at_startup with connect/disconnect menu entries and a global hotkey.

Verified: release assets contain no latest.json and curl https://qmahyar.github.io/qanatvpn/latest.json -> 404. The in-app updater's single-source-of-truth map was never produced for the only published release.
findings.fix: Decouple latest.json from android success: move the metadata job into its own workflow with workflow_run/needs on both build workflows using if: always(), or within this file add a second job fed by artifact upload/download so a single-platform failure still publishes a partial-but-real map (filters already tolerate missing platforms — the python l

findings.title: SPEC.md pins different Android SDK packages than the workflow and gradle actually use
findings.evidence: SPEC.md:120: 'sdkmanager --install "ndk;28.0.13004108" "platforms;android-36" "build-tools;36.0.0"'. Reality: build-android.yml 'Install pinned NDK + platform' runs 'sdkmanager --install "ndk;28.2.13676358" "platforms;android-37" "build-tools;37.0.0"' and android/app/build.gradle.kts:9-10 pins compileSdk = 37, ndkVersion = "28.2.13676358". (Both packages verified to exist in dl.google.com repository2-3.xml.) findings.title: The Windows 'sing-box version | Select-String awg' sanity gate cannot fail — it is decorative, unlike the android job's real check
findings.evidence: Doc/intent side: the step is positioned as a release sanity gate, mirroring build-android.yml's "Sanity — amneziawg symbols present, stub absent" which does fail (`strings ... | grep -q amneziawg || { echo "AWG missing — with_awg tag?"; exit 1; }`). Reality: build-windows.yml:39 is `sing-box version | Select-String awg` with no `if (-not ...) { throw }` — in the pwsh shell a Select-String with zero matches is an empty result, not an error, so the step exits 0 even when the awg tag is absent. Verified the current binary does contain it (`sing-box version` → "Tags: ...with_awg,with_purego", version 1.14.0-rc.1-awgm.15), but the gate would not catch a future regression.
findings.fix: Mirror the android job: `$v = sing-box version | Out-String; if ($v -notmatch 'awg') { throw 'AWG missing from sing-box build' }`.

findings.title: SPEC.md's build-windows CI description drifts from the workflow: c-shared DLL build + svenstaro uploader vs actual standalone exe + softprops; NDK/build-tools pins also differ
findings.evidence: Doc claim: SPEC.md:120 "`build-windows` (`windows-latest`): `flutter build windows` + `go build -buildmode=c-shared` + mingw dlls + `Compress-Archive` → zip + `svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2`". Reality: .github/workflows/build-windows.yml builds a standalone sing-box.exe (`go build -trimpath -buildvcs=false -ldflags ... -tags "...with_awg,with_purego" -o ../../windows/sing-box.exe ./cmd/sing-box` with CGO_ENABLED=0, no c-shared, no mingw dlls) and uploads via `uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2`. Same file also pins NDK "ndk;28.2.13676358" + "platforms;android-37" + "build-tools;37.0.0" while SPEC.md:120 documents "ndk;28.0.13004108 ... android-36 ... build-tools;36.0.0" (AGENTS.md's '
findings.fix: Update SPEC.md:120 to describe the actual pipeline (standalone exe, softprops, real NDK 28.2.13676358/android-37 pins) so future sessions don't 'restore' the c-shared/svenstaro design.

findings.title: Documented CI quality gates are not run in any job: no dart format gate, no golangci-lint, no sing-box check, no flutter test --coverage
findings.evidence: Doc claims: AGENTS.md Boundaries/Always "Run `flutter test --coverage` + `sing-box check` + `dart format` before commits"; SPEC.md:344 "Build 3 jobs parallel | CI | GitHub Actions: `strings libbox.so | grep -q amneziawg`, `flutter analyze`, `dart format`, `golangci-lint`, `sing-box check`, `flutter test --coverage`"; SPEC.md:324 "`dart format --set-exit-if-changed .` in CI before `flutter analyze`". Reality: build-windows.yml:41-48 "Flutter test + analyze" runs only `flutter pub get / flutter gen-l10n / flutter analyze / flutter test` (no --coverage flag, no format, no lint, no sing-box check); the same holds in build-android.yml. The documented gates are enforced nowhere in CI.
findings.fix: Add the documented gates to the shared test step (dart format --set-exit-if-changed ., flutter test --coverage with a threshold report, golangci-lint run ./..., and windows/sing-box.exe check -c profiles/config.wg-awg.json — cheap on the windows runner where the exe already exists), or amend AGENTS.md/SPEC to stop claiming CI enforces them.

findings.title: Windows release ships completely unsigned exes; signing is acknowledged in docs only for Android
findings.evidence: Reality: no signtool/certificate step exists in build-windows.yml (only checkout → go build → flutter test/build → Compress-Archive → softprops). Verified on the actual release asset: PowerShell Get-AuthenticodeSignature on the extracted binaries → sing-box.exe: "NotSigned — The file ... is not digitally signed."; qanatvpn.exe: "NotSigned". Doc side: tasks/handoff.md item 2 tracks signing only for Android ("release currently debug-signs — set the 4 GitHub secrets ... before any Play/manual distribution") and no doc acknowledges Windows SmartScreen friction; docs/site/index.html:62 advertises "Download ZIP" with no signature note.
findings.fix: Either add Authenticode signing (signtool with a certificate secret) in a step before Bundle zip, or document the unsigned state (SmartScreen 'More info → Run anyway') in README/site so users aren't silently filtered by SmartScreen reputation.

findings.title: sha256 sidecars are inconsistent across platforms and consumed by nothing — the app updates itself without verifying download integrity
findings.evidence: Reality (fetched asset): sha256-windows.json = {"qanatvpn_v0.1.0_windows-x64.zip":"d159f8065497ae602521aeb9f351c296ca5f1d32669cc0b5741d67e886bf8f9a"} (JSON object; recomputed hash of the zip matches). build-android.yml instead does `sha256sum "$name" >> sha256-android.json` — raw 'hash  name' lines inside a .json file (invalid JSON, different schema). Doc side: AGENTS.md:113 presents "+ `latest.json` + `sha256`" as part of the release guarantee. Grep of lib/**/*.dart for sha256|digest → no matches; updater.dart:93 returns `assetUrl: url` and downloads it directly, so nothing verifies the artifact hash.
findings.fix: Standardize one schema (the JSON object map) for both platforms, and add hash verification to the updater download path (compare against the sidecar via the release API or embed digests in latest.json) so the shipped hashes are actually consumed.

findings.title: README.md is still the untouched Flutter template stub for a shipping AGPL VPN product with a public release and a download site

A user landing on github.com/QMahyar/qanatvpn gets zero info about what the product is, how to install the unsigned zip, or its AGPL terms.

If a placeholder must stay, trigger only workflow_dispatch (not v* tags) and rename the job to `linux-pla

findings.title: gh-pages workflow_dispatch trigger is broken by design: TAG resolves to a branch name, so `gh release download "$TAG"` can never find a release
findings.evidence: Workflow line 6: `workflow_dispatch:`; line 25: `TAG: ${{ github.ref_name }}`; line 31: `gh release download "$TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"`. On a manual dispatch github.ref_name is the branch chosen in the UI (e.g. 'master'), so `gh release download master` finds no release → falls to the silent `|| echo "latest.json not on release yet — site ships without it"` (line 33) → site deploys without latest.json. Any remediation path that uses workflow_dispatch instead of re-running the failed tag run hits this immediately.
findings.fix: Resolve the tag inside the step (e.g. `gh release view --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --json tagName --jq .tagName` for the latest release) or accept an explicit `tag` workflow_dispatch input, instead of using github.ref_name for both triggers.

findings.title: "open a bump PR" step is pure narration — no PR is ever opened, and the only output is echo text including a Unicode em dash
findings.evidence: Reality: lines 18-34 contain only `git fetch --all --tags`, `git describe --tags || true`, `git log --oneline -5`, `PINNED=$(git -C go/amnezia-box rev-parse HEAD)`, and five `echo` lines ending in `echo "  → log to docs/decisions.tsv (what/why/evidence/result)"`. No `pulls.createOrUpdate`/gh pr step, no diff, no exit code. Doc: AGENTS.md 'Latest progress' and tasks/plan.md:170 prescribe the bump commit `chore(upstream): bump amnezia-box to 1.14-rc2 (with_awg)` as a real deliverable of the tracker. Also cosmetic: line 32 contains a Unicode em dash (→ shown as M-bM-^@M-^S in cat -A), which conflicts with the SPEC.md code-style rule 'no em dashes'.
findings.fix: Either implement the automation (on drift: fail the job + open an issue via gh api, PR creation is optional and can stay manual) or rename the step to 'Print bump instructions' so docs and file agree; replace the arrow with '->'.
